instructions.name: fulfill_order_via_route_swap
docs: Fulfill an order via Route Swap.
* `taking_amount`: overrides the order's taking amount (minimum output) when set
* `is_fee_in`: charge the fee on the order input (`true`) or on the route output (`false`)
* `third_fee_bps`: third party fee in basis points, needs the third fee recipient accounts
* `fee_step`: optional, charge the fee on the output of an intermediate step instead,
see `FeeStep`. Omit it (legacy clients) or pass `None` to keep the `is_fee_in` behavior.
The intermediate fee is taken inside the route, so the order's taking amount is
still enforced on the net output.
* `min_amount_out`: minimum amount out of this step
* `swap_type`: swap type of this step with respective parameters
* `remaining_accounts_count`: remaining accounts count for this step
* Remaining accounts: please refer to the route_swap instruction for more details.

instructions.name: route_swap_v2
docs: Same as `route_swap` with an extra `fee_payer` signer at account index 0.
`fee_payer` pays rent / ATA creation (and is the pump `user` for pump steps);
`authority` funds the swap and receives the output. For platform-relayed swaps
where the user wallet holds no SOL.
Rent goes back to whoever paid it: accounts the fee payer created for the route are closed
to the fee payer, the input token account the authority brought returns its rent to the
authority. With `wrap_and_unwrap_sol` the wrapped / unwrapped SOL is the authority's.

types.name: FeeStep
docs: Optional trailing argument of `route_swap` and `fulfill_order_via_route_swap`: charge the
fee on the output of step `index` (an intermediate token) instead of on the route input /
* `fee_bps` / `third_fee_bps` are applied to the gross output of step `index`, i.e. its
output token account balance increase, before it becomes the input of the next step.
* `is_fee_in` is ignored: no fee is charged on the route input or output, so a route is
* Like the input / output fee, nothing is charged when `fee_bps == 0` (the third fee
of the fee recipient for that intermediate mint, under the mint's token program
(Token or Token-2022); it is created if it does not exist.
* `min_amount_out` of step `index` is checked against the gross output, before the fee.
Encoding: Borsh layout is identical to `Option<u8>`:
* no byte at all (EOF) -> `None`: clients built before this argument existed keep working
* `0x00` -> `None`: no intermediate fee, `is_fee_in` decides as before.
Errors: `InvalidFeeStepIndex` if `index` is not an intermediate step, `InvalidFeeBps` if
token account is not the expected ATA or is the bridge account itself.
Limitations (same as the input / output fee): the fee is moved with a plain
`transfer_checked`, so a Token-2022 intermediate mint with a transfer hook makes the
transaction fail (the hook's extra accounts are not passed), and with a transfer fee
extension the logged `fee` is the amount sent, the recipient receives less.

fields.name: index
docs: 0-based index of the step whose output is charged, `0..=steps.len() - 2`.
